figures.caption: Fig. 2. Case study comparing diagnosis with and without experience memory. The retrieved pairwise note provides actionable discriminators that guide correct diagnosis.

Table 2. Main results. Baseline: zero-shot diagnosis. w/Exp: diagnosis augmented with experience memory. Recall: proportion of cases with successfully retrieved notes. Precision: accuracy on cases where notes were retrieved. Beneficial: proportion of cases always corrected by experience memory (wrong → correct). Harmful: proportion of cases always misled by experience memory (correct → wrong).
